local self=require('openmw.self')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local frames=0
local timer=0
local reported=false
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 frames=frames+1
 local dead=Actor.isDead(self)
 local health=Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current
 if frames==5 and not dead and health>0 then print('Cavern retry alive health='..health) end
 if dead and not reported then reported=true print('Cavern retry player dead health='..health) end
 timer=timer+dt
 if timer>=1 then timer=0 print('Cavern retry state dead='..tostring(dead)..' health='..health) end
end}}}}
